exclusion_rule: none: any unexpected failure aborts the run; doctor_unreachable samples whose output lacks the configured_unreachable state abort the run (no silent exclusion)
budget_basis: frozen before measuring from an untimed pre-study: one doctor run is a CLI subprocess + mTLS handshake + policy readback observed at ~1-3 s, so readback budgets are ~5x the observed pre-study p95; apply_rollback_service is apply+readback+nil-authorizer-refusal+rollback through the live driver, budgeted at ~4x the readback budget.

level_discipline.service_level_reason: openshell 0.0.83 does not expose per-request gateway latency
level_discipline.rss_semantics: children_peak_rss_kb is a cumulative max over all children; per-sample deltas not meaningful, recorded once
